task.title: Sheep stop and ask
task.original: Sheep cannot reach the user but skills told them to ask; stop inventing answers — emit open_questions, orchestrator asks and re-spawns.

story: sheep emit open_questions · orchestrator asks · fresh re-spawn · pause-context for spec/subtasks · describe escalates · conflicts stay with sheep · ask lines rewritten · reviews/ graveyard cleared

decisions.decision: Orchestrator only — Nicki on the pipeline, parent agent ad-hoc. Never a sheep.
Structured entries in the return's open_questions (question required; options and context optional). No schema, no validator.
Named only in nicki-default.mdc and CLAUDE.md — never in shared agent or skill files.
Fresh spawn carrying the answers; disk carries work state. No Cursor Task resume.
Caller-named path; write only when stopping with a question; read only when prompt says resume; delete on completion; never in status.artifacts.
Escalates — orchestrator runs Gherkin interview and approval; sheep-describe writes the approved story.
Stay with the sheep — pause on conflicted tree, return inventory as questions, re-spawn applies resolutions verbatim.
Rewritten to return the question in open_questions and stop, including missing-input cases.
Deleted as live paths — no mkdir in create-worktree, no artifacts.review_validation, no live format/doc rows.

suggestions.suggestion: Dogfood a live conflict pause round-trip (sync or integrate) so inventory → orchestrator AskQuestion → re-spawn apply stays exercised end-to-end.
suggestions.evidence: Subtasks confirmed conflict-resolution shape and hard gate; most steps were confirm-already rather than a live merge pause.

suggestions.suggestion: Dogfood a paused spec sheep: resume from caller-named pause file, then confirm the file is gone on completion and ignored when not named.
suggestions.evidence: Acceptance and walkthrough subtask cover this; pause-context already exists — live proof still thin.
